Question Choices: Find the distance between -3 and 9 using absolute value. Fill in the blanks: The subtraction expression inside the absolute value is |-3 - 9| = |___|, so the distance is ___.
Hints: Distance = absolute value of the difference. The difference may be negative, but distance cannot be.
Solution: |-3 - 9| = |-12| = 12. The same formula applies whether the positions are on the same or opposite sides of zero. Exact check: -3-9 = -12; abs(-3-9) = 12.

Question Choices: The final temperature after a change of +18° is 5°. What was the starting temperature? Enter only the number with no units.
Hints: Use inverse operations on both sides and substitute the answer into the original equation.
Solution: Initial = 5 - 18 = -13. Let the blank be x: x+18 = 5. Solving gives x = -13. Substitute: (-13)+18 = 5. Exact check: 5-18 = -13.
